method: Cross-check of reading/names_lb.py against DAMOS (Database of Mycenaean at Oslo, damos.hf.uio.no; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). The DAMOS word search was queried on 23 Sept 2026 for every common word of three or more signs (regular expression ^[^-]+-[^-]+-[^-]+; 10,198 tokens, 4,162 types, 3,106 items; KN 3,943 tokens, PY 5,268, TH 634, MY 279, KH 18, others 55). The 491 Linear A word types of three or more signs were matched against it exactly. Excerpts below are DAMOS line texts, quoted briefly for attestation.
not_found_in_damos: A-KA-TA (matched a-ka-ta in the linearb.xyz Pylos list)

damos: 57 Knossos attestations, mostly the D- sheep series (e.g. KN Dn 1094: pa-i-to OVIS:m 1509)
22 Knossos attestations (As, Da-Do, Lc, Sd, So...)
6 Knossos attestations, all D- sheep series

reading: DAMOS reproduces the linearb.xyz result: every shared name is a Knossos word, every mainland match a Greek common word at Pylos. The Knossos contexts of the personal names are entries in lists of persons or holdings with small counts (TA-NA-TI DA 1, I-TA-JA MUL 1, PA-RA-NE 1), the same function the words have in Linear A lists (TA-NA-TI 1 on HT 7a, a list of men). The names are used the same way in both scripts.
